entries.definitionCN: 琐碎的；不重要的

entries.definition: something of little importance
entries.definitionCN: 琐事；无足轻重

entries.definition: the act of making something seem unimportant
entries.definitionCN: 轻视化；淡化

entries.definition: to make a person or thing seem small or unimportant
entries.definitionCN: 贬低；使显得渺小

entries.definition: to make something seem less important than it is
entries.definitionCN: 轻描淡写；淡化

entries.definition: to rate something lower than it deserves
entries.definitionCN: 低估；轻视

normalIntro.en: Trivialize is the verb of the crossroads: whatever is set down there becomes common and small.
normalIntro.cn: trivialize 是「路口」的动词：任何东西一旦被放到那里，就变平常、变小。

normal.en: To trivialize an issue is to call it too small to matter.
normal.cn: to trivialize an issue 就是把问题说得太小、不值一提。

normal.en: Trivialize shares its base with trivial and triviality.
normal.cn: trivialize 与 trivial、triviality 共享同一个词干。

normal.en: The suffix -ize turns trivial into a verb, as in modernize and standardize.
normal.cn: 后缀 -ize 把 trivial 变成动词，就像 modernize 与 standardize 一样。

normal.en: Do not trivialize their loss is a common warning in grief writing.
normal.cn: 在谈悲伤的文章里，常见提醒不要轻视他人的失去。

normal.en: Compare downplay: downplay tones down emphasis, trivialize goes further and denies weight.
normal.cn: 对比 downplay：downplay 只是减弱强调，trivialize 更进一步，直接否认分量。

abstract.en: Picture a heavy tower being rebuilt from pebbles at a crossroads.
abstract.cn: 想象一座沉重的塔在三岔路口被用鹅卵石重新砌成。

abstract.en: Imagine a speaker shrinking a whole problem to a single shrug.
abstract.cn: 想象一个发言人把整个难题缩成一次耸肩。

abstract.en: Think of a hard puzzle whose pieces are all sanded down to round beads.
abstract.cn: 想象一块难拼的拼图，每块都被磨圆成珠子，再也拼不成形。

examples.en: It is unfair to trivialize the worries of young workers.
examples.cn: 把年轻员工的担忧看得无关紧要，是不公平的。

examples.en: The article trivializes a complex debate into a slogan.
examples.cn: 这篇文章把一场复杂的辩论简化成了一句口号。

examples.en: By trivializing small warnings, the city missed the danger.
examples.cn: 由于轻视了一个个小小的警告，这座城市错过了危险信号。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「吹味儿」——把事情吹成一股味儿就散了，等于把大事说成小事；这只是读音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 tri-（三）+ via（路）→ trivium（三岔路口）→ trivialis（街头寻常的、琐碎的）→ 英语 trivial → 动词 trivialize，核心义「把重的东西摆到街头，让它变轻变碎」。

sensesIntro.en: Trivialize starts from making a serious thing seem small, then moves to the way it is described, the complexity it strips away, and finally to things becoming light through overuse.
sensesIntro.cn: trivialize 从「把严重的事说小」出发，进而指这样说的方式、被剥掉的复杂性，最后指事物因滥用而变轻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a heavy tower taken apart into small stones at a crossroads.
core.cn: 核心意象：沉重的塔在三岔路口被拆成小石子。

branches.en: Calling a real disaster small is the central sense.
branches.cn: 把真实的灾难说小，是中心义项。

branches.en: The way of describing is the talking sense.
branches.cn: 描述方式本身构成「如何说」的义项。

branches.en: Cutting difficulty into pieces is the oversimplifying sense.
branches.cn: 把难度切成碎块，是「简单化」的义项。

branches.en: Small words and small descriptions both shrink the same matter.
branches.cn: 小词与小描述，缩小的是同一件事。

branches.en: A simplified version and an overused term both lose the weight they once had.
branches.cn: 简化版本与滥用术语，都失去了原本的分量。

intro.en: Trivialize is assembled from trivial and the verb suffix -ize, and the family circles around trivial, triviality, and trivialization.
intro.cn: trivialize 由 trivial 加动词后缀 -ize 构成，词族围绕 trivial、triviality 与 trivialization 展开。

latinIntro.en: Latin trivium joins tri, three, and via, road, and the adjective trivialis grew from the crossroads where ordinary life happened.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 trivium 由 tri（三）与 via（路）合成，形容词 trivialis 从发生日常生活的三岔路口生长出来。

items.example: The prefix tri- appears in triangle and triple.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 tri- 出现在 triangle 与 triple 中。

items.example: Via means a road in Latin.
items.exampleCN: via 在拉丁语中意为道路。

items.meaning: a place where three roads meet
items.example: Trivium names the meeting of three roads.
items.exampleCN: trivium 指三条路交会之处。

items.example: Trivialis describes what belongs to the street.
items.exampleCN: trivialis 描述属于街头的东西。

items.example: Trivial keeps the ordinary sense.
items.exampleCN: trivial 保留了「寻常琐碎」的意思。

items.meaningCN: 表示状态或性质的名词后缀
items.example: The suffix -ity forms triviality.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ity 构成 triviality。

items.meaningCN: 表示「使成为」的动词后缀
items.example: The suffix -ize turns trivial into trivialize.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ize 把 trivial 变成 trivialize。

items.meaningCN: 表示行为或过程的名词后缀
items.example: The suffix -ation forms trivialization.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ation 构成 trivialization。

items.example: The prefix non- forms nontrivial.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 non- 构成 nontrivial。

definition_zh: 长号（铜管乐器）；伸缩喇叭
definition_en: a brass instrument with a long sliding tube that the player moves to change the pitch
core_image: 一支亮黄的长铜管，演奏者把拉管一推一拉，低沉的音就从管口滑出来
scene: 乐队排练时，后排的胖男孩把长号拉管一送，浑厚的低音立刻盖住了整个铜管声部。In rehearsal, the boy in the back row moved the trombone slide out and a warm bass note filled the brass section.
sceneCN: 这里 trombone 是「长号」（第 1 个义项：铜管乐器长号）；句意：排练时后排的男孩把长号的拉管推出去，温暖的低音填满了半个铜管声部。

pos.zh: 长号；伸缩长号（铜管乐器）

derivatives.zh: 长号加表示演奏者的后缀 -ist 构成，义为「长号手」
长号在文艺复兴时期的前身，义为「萨克布特」（早期长号）
意大利语「喇叭、小号」，是 trombone 的词干

senses.title: The orchestral slide brass instrument
senses.definition: a large brass instrument of the orchestra, famous for sliding the tube to reach each note
senses.definitionCN: 管弦乐队中的大型铜管乐器，以滑动管身到达每个音高而著名
senses.example: The orchestra opened with a soaring trombone solo.
senses.exampleCN: 乐队以一段高亢的长号独奏开场。
senses.why: The Italian name came from the big trumpet, and the slide gives the family member its own name in English use.
senses.whyCN: 意大利语原名意为「大号的小号」，拉管让这个铜管家族成员在英语使用中拥有了自己的名字。

senses.title: The tenor voice of the brass section
senses.definition: the warm, round tenor tone that the instrument lends to the brass section
senses.definitionCN: 乐器为铜管声部带来的温暖浑圆的次中音
senses.example: The trombone carries the melody in many jazz ballads.
senses.exampleCN: 许多爵士抒情曲都由长号来承担主旋律。
senses.why: Because the tube is long and the bowl is wide, the instrument sits low in the brass choir, from which its dark tenor colour comes.
senses.whyCN: 因为管身长、喇叭口宽，它在铜管合唱中处于低音位置，深沉的次中音音色由此而来。

senses.title: The trombonist in a band
senses.definition: a player of the instrument, especially in a jazz or marching band
senses.definitionCN: 演奏这种乐器的人，尤指爵士乐队或行进乐队中的乐手
senses.example: The trombone swung hard on the final chorus.
senses.exampleCN: 长号手在最后一遍副歌里摇摆得十分起劲。
senses.why: Band talk commonly names the musician by the instrument, so the noun shifts from the object to the person.
senses.whyCN: 乐队口语里常用乐器代指乐手，于是这个名词从物转到人。

senses.title: An organ trombone stop
senses.definition: a loud reed stop on a pipe organ intended to imitate the instrument
senses.definitionCN: 管风琴上模仿长号音色的大音量簧管音栓
senses.example: Pull the trombone when the hymn reaches its climax.
senses.exampleCN: 当圣歌到达高潮时，拉出长号音栓。
senses.why: The loud brass sound was imitated by organ builders, so the instrument name moved into the vocabulary of stops.
senses.whyCN: 管风琴制造者模仿这种嘹亮的铜管声，于是乐器名进入了音栓的词汇。

senses.title: Slang for a boaster
senses.titleCN: 俚语：说大话的人；自吹者
senses.definition: old slang for a person who talks himself up loudly, like a brass instrument that plays every note
senses.definitionCN: 旧时俚语，指大声自我吹嘘的人，像一件每个音都要吹响的铜管乐器
senses.example: They called the loudest boy at the club a trombone.
senses.exampleCN: 俱乐部里最爱大声说话的男孩被叫作长号。
senses.why: The Italian verb behind the name means to trumpet, so the loud image lent itself easily to a person who trumpets himself.
senses.whyCN: 名字背后的意大利语动词意为「吹喇叭」，响亮的形象自然被借来指自吹自擂之人。

senses.title: The slide-like tube itself
senses.definition: the long inner tube that slides inside the outer tube to lengthen the instrument
senses.definitionCN: 在外管内来回滑动、用来延长管身的内管
senses.example: The slide of the trombone catches the light as it moves.
senses.exampleCN: 长号的滑动管移动时会映出亮光。
senses.why: This is the most concrete branch: the word names the moving part, and the part sells the whole instrument to the listener.
senses.whyCN: 这是最具体的一个分支：词指那个滑动的部件，而部件本身就是这件乐器给人的全部印象。

senses.title: A slide trombone with a valve
senses.titleCN: 带活塞的长号；阀仕长号
senses.definition: a member of the family fitted with valves as well as a slide, often for players who need quick changes
senses.definitionCN: 同时装有活塞和拉管的长号变体，通行于需要快速换音的乐手
senses.example: He switched to a valve trombone for the fast passage.
senses.exampleCN: 面对那段快速乐句，他改用了活塞长号。
senses.why: Once the aim is to fill a musical gap quickly, players add a mechanism, so the same name covers a family of nearby instruments.
senses.whyCN: 一旦目标变成快速补上某个音，乐手就会增加机关，于是同一个名字覆盖了一组近亲乐器。

intro.en: Trombone is an Italian word built from tromba, trumpet, and the augmentative ending -one, so it literally names a big trumpet.
intro.cn: trombone 是意大利语词，由 tromba（喇叭、小号）加上增大的后缀 -one 构成，字面意思就是「大号的小号」。

items.en: A brass or war trumpet is called tuba in late Latin, the source of the Romance trumpet words.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语把铜制或军用的喇叭称为 tuba，是罗曼语族各种「喇叭」词的源头。

items.en: The Romance word tromba comes through the sense of blowing, giving the trumpet name in Italian.
items.cn: 罗曼语词 tromba 经由「吹奏」这层意思而来，成为意大利语里的喇叭名。

items.en: The augmentative trombone names the big trumpet, the ancestor known in English as the sackbut.
items.cn: 增大式 trombone 指「大喇叭」，即英语里称作萨克布特的早期长号。

items.en: Trombone is borrowed into English to name the sliding brass instrument used in orchestras.
items.cn: trombone 被借入英语，用以指管弦乐队中带拉管的铜管乐器。

items.en: The word spreads into jazz bands and instrument brands, and the player becomes the trombonist.
items.cn: 这个词进入爵士乐队与乐器品牌，演奏者则有了 trombonist 这个称呼。

note.en: Trombone belongs to the tube extended by a slide, and its near words are the other brass instruments of the orchestra.
note.cn: trombone 属于靠拉管延长的铜管乐器，它周围的近义词是管弦乐队里的其他铜管乐器。

entries.definition: Italian for trumpet, the base of the instrument name
entries.definitionCN: 意大利语「小号、喇叭」，是乐器名的词干

entries.definition: a player of the trombone
entries.definitionCN: 长号手

entries.definition: a high brass instrument, only loosely related in spelling
entries.definitionCN: 高音铜管乐器小号；与 trombone 只是拼写略近，词源并不相同

entries.definition: the lowest brass instrument of the orchestra
entries.definitionCN: 管弦乐队中最低音的铜管乐器

entries.definition: a coiled brass instrument with a soft round tone
entries.definitionCN: 圆号，音色柔和圆润的盘绕铜管乐器

entries.definition: a family of valved brass instruments used in bands
entries.definitionCN: 军乐队中用阀演奏的一族铜管乐器

normalIntro.en: Trombone said aloud stretches like the slide itself: trom plus bone, a long tube with an arm.
normalIntro.cn: 把 trombone 读出来，声音像拉管一样被拉长：前半像喇叭，后半像一根长骨头。

normal.en: Trombone has the same base as tromba, the Italian word for trumpet.
normal.cn: trombone 与 tromba（意大利语「喇叭」）同源。

normal.en: The -one ending makes a word bigger, as in cartone, a big carta.
normal.cn: 后缀 -one 表示「大」，例如 cartone 就是大张的 carta（纸）。

normal.en: The trombonist is the player, formed with the suffix -ist.
normal.cn: trombonist 是演奏者，用后缀 -ist 构成。

normal.en: You play the trombone; you do not blow the trombone in English.
normal.cn: 英语里说 play the trombone，不说 blow the trombone。

normal.en: Compare trumpet: the trumpet uses valves, the trombone uses a slide.
normal.cn: 对比 trumpet：小号靠活塞，长号靠拉管。

abstract.en: See a golden arm reaching out of the brass section and pulling a long tube back in.
abstract.cn: 想象一只金色的手臂从铜管声部伸出来，把长长的管子拉回去。

abstract.en: Hear one round low note held under the trumpets like a warm floor.
abstract.cn: 想象在嘹亮的小号底下，有一条低沉浑圆的音托着。

abstract.en: Picture a train sliding on one rail: that is how the slide finds every note.
abstract.cn: 想象一列火车只靠一根轨道滑行，拉管就是这样找到每个音的。

examples.en: She has played the trombone since she was ten.
examples.cn: 她从十岁起就开始吹长号。

examples.en: The trombone section warmed up in the empty hall.
examples.cn: 长号声部在空荡的大厅里热了热身。

examples.en: A friendly trombonist let me hold his trombone after the concert.
examples.cn: 一位友善的长号手在音乐会后让我拿他的长号。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「戳猛崩」——拉管一戳一拉，崩出一声浑厚低音；这只是读音联想，与词源无关。

root: 意大利语 tromba（喇叭、小号）→ 增大词尾 -one → trombone（大号的小号），经意大利语借入英语，核心义「被拉长、放大的喇叭」。

sensesIntro.en: Trombone begins as the orchestral instrument, then names its tenor sound, its player, its organ imitation, and finally its sliding part and its noisiest slang life.
sensesIntro.cn: trombone 先指管弦乐队里的乐器，再指它的次中音音色、演奏者、管风琴上的模仿音栓，最后延伸到滑动的管子与俚语用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long golden tube extended by a hand pulling the slide.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手拉动滑管，把长长的金铜管身延长。

branches.en: The orchestra instrument is the central sense.
branches.cn: 管弦乐队的乐器是中心义项。

branches.en: The warm tenor colour is the sound sense.
branches.cn: 温暖浑厚的次中音是音色义项。

branches.en: The player is named after the instrument in band talk.
branches.cn: 在乐队口语里，乐手以乐器命名。

branches.en: The instrument and its sliding tube are the same object seen whole or in part.
branches.cn: 乐器与滑动管是同一物体的整体与局部。

branches.en: The loud brass sound lends its name to an organ stop and to a loud talker.
branches.cn: 响亮的铜管声把名字借给了管风琴音栓与爱吹嘘的人。

intro.en: Trombone is a loan from Italian, built with the augmentative suffix -one, and it belongs to the brass family along with trumpet, trombonist, and sackbut.
intro.cn: trombone 是从意大利语借来的词，用增大式后缀 -one 构成，与 trumpet、trombonist、sackbut 同属铜管词族。

latinIntro.en: The chain runs from the classical tuba through the late Latin and Romance names for a trumpet to the Italian tromba and its big form trombone.
latinIntro.cn: 这条链条从古典拉丁语的 tuba，经晚期拉丁语与罗曼语族各种「喇叭」名，走到意大利语 tromba 及其增大形式 trombone。

items.example: Tromba is the Italian word for trumpet.
items.exampleCN: tromba 是意大利语里的喇叭、小号。

items.example: The suffix -one makes a thing bigger, as in trombone.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -one 使事物变大，trombone 正是如此。

items.example: Voice and horn both carry this loud image.
items.exampleCN: 人声与号角都带着这种响亮的形象。

items.meaning: the big trumpet, later the slide instrument
items.meaningCN: 大喇叭，后来指带拉管的铜管乐器
items.example: Trombone names the great trumpet and its sliding descendant.
items.exampleCN: trombone 既指大喇叭，也指延续它的滑管乐器。

items.meaning: a person who plays or practises
items.meaningCN: 表示演奏者或从业者的名词后缀
items.example: The suffix -ist forms trombonist.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ist 构成 trombonist。

items.example: Trombonist names the player, not the instrument.
items.exampleCN: trombonist 指演奏者而非乐器。

items.meaning: the moving tube of the instrument
items.example: The slide lengthens the tube smoothly.
items.exampleCN: 拉管可以平滑地延长管身。

items.meaning: the early form of the trombone
items.example: Sackbut is the older English name of the instrument.
items.exampleCN: sackbut 是这种乐器较早的英语名称。

items.meaning: a finger button that changes the length of the tube
items.example: The valve is the trumpet solution to the same problem.
items.exampleCN: 阀键是小号解决同一问题的办法。

definition_zh: 对流层（大气最低的一层）；天气活动发生的低层大气
definition_en: the lowest layer of the atmosphere, where clouds form and the temperature falls with height
core_image: 地球裹着一层不断翻滚的被子，云在其中升腾、雨在其中落下，热空气在这里来回搅动
scene: 夏日午后，积云在对流层里迅速堆高，远处响起第一声雷。On a summer afternoon, the thunderclouds pile up quickly inside the troposphere and the first thunder rolls far away.
sceneCN: 这里 troposphere 是「对流层」（第 1 个义项：紧贴地面、天气活动最活跃的低层大气）；句意：夏日午后，积雨云在对流层里迅速堆高，远处响起初雷。

pos.zh: 对流层；气象学用语，指大气最底部的翻转层

derivatives.zh: 名词加形容词后缀 -ic 构成，义为「对流层的」
由 tropo- 与 pause（停顿）合成，义为「对流层顶」
对流层上方的一层，由 strato-（层状）与 -sphere 构成，义为「平流层」

senses.title: The lowest layer of the atmosphere
senses.definition: the bottommost shell of the atmosphere, where the air turns over and the weather happens
senses.definitionCN: 大气最底部的壳层，空气在其中不断翻转，天气变化也发生在这里
senses.example: Almost all water vapour stays inside the troposphere.
senses.exampleCN: 几乎所有的水汽都留存在对流层里。
senses.why: The Greek base trepein means to turn, so the layer is named for the air that turns over inside it.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语词干 trepein 意为「翻转」，这一层就是因层内空气不停翻转而得名的。

senses.title: The layer where the weather forms
senses.definition: the zone of clouds, rain, wind, and storms reached by people on the ground
senses.definitionCN: 云、雨、风与风暴所在的区域，也是地面的人所经历的天气
senses.example: Every storm we watch from the ground grows in the troposphere.
senses.exampleCN: 我们从地面看到的每一场风暴，都在对流层里生长。
senses.why: Because water vapour is locked up near the ground, the turning layer is also the only layer where clouds can rise and rain can fall.
senses.whyCN: 由于水汽聚在近地面，这层翻转的空气同时也是唯一能升云落雨的一层。

senses.title: The layer of cooling with height
senses.definition: the part of the air in which temperature drops as you climb upward
senses.definitionCN: 向上爬升时温度不断下降的那部分大气
senses.example: In the troposphere, it is colder at the top than at the surface.
senses.exampleCN: 在对流层里，顶部的空气比地面更冷。
senses.why: The same turning motion moves heat upward, so the layer is marked off by the cooling trend that ends at its top.
senses.whyCN: 同样这种翻转运动把热量往上带，因此这一层以「越往上越冷」的趋势为界，并在层顶终止。

senses.title: The mixing layer of the planet
senses.definition: the well-stirred shell that carries pollution, dust, and heat from the surface through the air
senses.definitionCN: 被充分搅动的一层，把污染物、尘埃与热量从地面带入空中
senses.example: Dust from the desert can cross the troposphere in a single week.
senses.exampleCN: 沙漠扬尘可以在一周内横穿对流层。
senses.why: Stirred air carries things along with it, so a name made from turning also describes a great mixing bowl for the planet.
senses.whyCN: 被搅动的空气会带着东西一起流动，所以「翻转」之名同样描述了这颗行星的一只大搅拌碗。

senses.title: The air we breathe and fly in
senses.titleCN: 日常呼吸与飞行的低层大气
senses.definition: the layer that holds most of the air by mass and most of the flights of aircraft
senses.definitionCN: 按质量包含了大部分空气、并容纳大多数飞机航线的一层
senses.example: Jet aircraft cruise above the troposphere to save fuel.
senses.exampleCN: 喷气式客机在对流层上方巡航以节省燃料。
senses.why: Most of the air by mass sits low, so the lowest layer is also the daily layer of breathing and of ordinary flight.
senses.whyCN: 大部分空气按质量压在低处，因此最低的一层也是日常呼吸与普通飞行的所在。

senses.title: A figurative turbulent zone
senses.titleCN: 比喻义：动荡翻滚的领域
senses.definition: a figurative region where ideas or events are constantly churning and changing
senses.definitionCN: 比喻说法，指观点或事件不断翻滚、变化的领域
senses.example: The blogger called social media a troposphere of argument.
senses.exampleCN: 这位博主把社交媒体称为一片争论的对流层。
senses.why: The turning image is vivid enough to be borrowed, and writers call any turbulent field a troposphere in jest.
senses.whyCN: 「翻转」的画面感很强，足以被借用，于是写作的人会戏称任何动荡之地为对流层。

intro.en: Troposphere joins Greek tropos, a turning, with -sphaira, sphere, and was coined in the twentieth century for the turning air near the ground.
intro.cn: troposphere 由希腊语 tropos（翻转）与 -sphaira（球体）合成，是二十世纪为近地面那层「翻转的空气」造出的新词。

items.en: Tropos means a turn, especially a turn of argument or of the mind.
items.cn: tropos 意为翻转、转向，尤指论述或心思的转向。

items.en: Sphaira means a ball or globe, the source of sphere.
items.cn: sphaira 意为球体、圆球，是 sphere 的来源。

items.en: The noun troposphère is used in meteorology for the lower layer of the air.
items.cn: 气象学中的法语名词 troposphère 用来指低层空气。

items.en: English borrows the name as troposphere, and the upper boundary becomes the tropopause.
items.cn: 英语借入这个词写作 troposphere，其上限则称为 tropopause（对流层顶）。

items.en: Careful meteorology in the twentieth century ties the word to the weather and to the thickest layer of the atmosphere.
items.cn: 二十世纪细致的气象学研究把这词固定在天气与大气最厚的一层之上。

note.en: Troposphere is the lowest shell of the atmosphere, formed from the Greek word for turning, and its near words are the other named layers of air.
note.cn: troposphere 是大气最低的一层壳，构词来自希腊语「翻转」，近义词是其他有名目的大气层。

entries.definition: the upper boundary of the troposphere
entries.definitionCN: 对流层顶，即对流层的上限

entries.definition: relating to the troposphere
entries.definitionCN: 与对流层有关的

entries.definition: of the tropics, a different word despite the opening letters
entries.definitionCN: 热带的；虽以 trop- 开头，但来自 tropikos 而非 tropos，只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: the calm layer of ozone-bearing air above the troposphere
entries.definitionCN: 对流层上方含臭氧的平静气层

entries.definition: the whole blanket of gases around the earth
entries.definitionCN: 环绕地球的整个气体层

entries.definition: the middle layer of the atmosphere where meteors burn
entries.definitionCN: 大气中层，流星在此燃烧

normalIntro.en: Troposphere is built from tropos, a turn, and sphere, a ball: the turning ball of air around the earth.
normalIntro.cn: troposphere 由 tropos（翻转）与 sphere（球）构成：绕地球翻转的那只空气球。

normal.en: The troposphere is the layer where air turns over, from the Greek verb for turning.
normal.cn: troposphere 是空气翻转的那一层，来自希腊语「翻转」一词。

normal.en: Tropospheric is the adjective, as in tropospheric ozone.
normal.cn: tropospheric 是对应的形容词，例如对流层臭氧。

normal.en: Tropopause ends the layer; tropo- plus pause means the stop of the turning.
normal.cn: 对流层的终点叫 tropopause：tropo- 加 pause，意为「翻转停下来的地方」。

normal.en: The suffix -sphere appears in atmosphere, stratosphere, and mesosphere.
normal.cn: 后缀 -sphere 也出现在 atmosphere、stratosphere 与 mesosphere 中。

normal.en: Compare stratosphere: layers in the stratosphere are calm, the troposphere turns.
normal.cn: 对比 stratosphere：平流层里分层安静，而对流层不停翻转。

abstract.en: Picture a transparent belt around the earth where clouds rise and fall like the lid of a boiling pot.
abstract.cn: 想象地球腰间一条透明的带子，云像沸锅的锅盖一样上下起伏。

abstract.en: Hear the rain hitting your window: that knock happened inside the troposphere.
abstract.cn: 听雨点敲窗的声音：那一下敲击就发生在对流层里。

abstract.en: Imagine climbing a mountain and feeling the cold hug of the same layer.
abstract.cn: 想象你爬上山峰，被同一层的冷空气抱个满怀。

examples.en: Clouds and storms live almost entirely in the troposphere.
examples.cn: 云和风暴几乎完全生活在对流层里。

examples.en: The troposphere is warmer at the surface than at its top.
examples.cn: 对流层在地面比在顶部更暖。

examples.en: Pilots often fly above the troposphere to escape turbulence.
examples.cn: 飞行员常在对流层上方飞行以避开颠簸。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「戳破天」——这层空气一直向上戳，一层层翻滚云雨；这只是读音联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 tropos（翻转、转向）+ sphaira（球）→ 现代科学构词 -sphere → 法语 troposphère → 英语 troposphere，核心义「绕地球不停翻转的空气球层」。

sensesIntro.en: Troposphere begins with the literal bottom shell of air, then gathers the weather, the cooling trend, the mixing work, the daily breathing air, and finally a borrowed turbulence.
sensesIntro.cn: troposphere 从字面上的最底层空气出发，继而汇集了天气、降温趋势、混合作用、日常呼吸的空气，最后是借用的「动荡」比喻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a turning blanket of air wrapped around the earth.
core.cn: 核心意象：一层绕着地球不断翻转的空气毯。

branches.en: The lowest air shell is the literal sense.
branches.cn: 最底层的空气壳是字面义项。

branches.en: Weather happening is the cloud sense.
branches.cn: 天气发生之地是云与雨的义项。

branches.en: The cooling with height is the boundary sense.
branches.cn: 随高度降温是界定层界的义项。

branches.en: The stirred shell that carries dust is the same turning air at work.
branches.cn: 载着尘埃的搅动层与翻转的空气是同一件事在起作用。

branches.en: The air we fly in and the borrowed turbulent zone both draw on the daily layer.
branches.cn: 我们飞行其中的空气与被借用的动荡领域，都源自这层日常空气。

intro.en: Troposphere is a modern scientific compound: the Greek root tropo- for turning plus the combining form -sphere, and its family includes tropopause, tropospheric, and stratosphere.
intro.cn: troposphere 是现代科学复合词：希腊词根 tropo-（翻转）加组合形式 -sphere，词族中有 tropopause、tropospheric 与 stratosphere。

latinIntro.en: The parts are Greek rather than Latin, so the same family is listed here for comparison with the rest of the vocabulary.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词的部件来自希腊语而非拉丁语，这里把它们列出来，便于与词汇中其他词根对照。

items.example: The form tropo- marks the turning air.
items.exampleCN: 组合形式 tropo- 标记「翻转的空气」。

items.example: Trepein means to turn in Greek.
items.exampleCN: trepein 在希腊语中意为翻转。

items.example: The form -sphere forms atmosphere and hemisphere.
items.exampleCN: 组合形式 -sphere 构成 atmosphere 与 hemisphere。

items.example: Sphaira is the source of sphere.
items.exampleCN: sphaira 是 sphere 的来源。

items.example: The form -pause forms tropopause.
items.exampleCN: 组合形式 -pause 构成 tropopause。

items.meaningCN: 表示「与……有关的」形容词后缀
items.example: The suffix -ic forms tropospheric.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ic 构成 tropospheric。

items.example: The form strato- forms stratosphere.
items.exampleCN: 组合形式 strato- 构成 stratosphere。

items.example: The form atmo- forms atmosphere.
items.exampleCN: 组合形式 atmo- 构成 atmosphere。

items.example: The form meso- forms mesosphere.
items.exampleCN: 组合形式 meso- 构成 mesosphere。

definition_zh: 对流层的；与对流层有关的；发生在对流层内的
definition_en: relating to the troposphere, the lowest layer of the atmosphere, or happening within it
core_image: 一层翻涌的云海：暖空气上升、冷空气下沉，水汽在其中不断打转
scene: 山地气象站里，学生盯着屏幕上不断滚动的曲线。The storm grew because moisture in the tropospheric air was pushed upward and cooled quickly.
sceneCN: 这里 tropospheric 是「对流层的」（第 1 个义项：与大气最底层有关的）；句意为暴风雨增强，是因为对流层空气中的水汽被推升并迅速冷却。

pos.zh: 形容词：对流层的；与对流层有关的

derivatives.zh: 由「转动」词根加 -sphere（球层）构成，形容词去词尾复得名词，义为「对流层」
由形容词加副词词尾 -ally 构成，义为「在对流层范围内」
由「层」词根 stratum 换前缀构成，义为「平流层的」，是 tropospheric 的相邻层形容词
由希腊语 mesos「中间」加球层词构成，义为「中间层的」，与对流层上下相邻

senses.title: Belonging to the troposphere
senses.definition: relating to the troposphere, the lowest and densest layer of the atmosphere, where clouds and weather form
senses.definitionCN: 与对流层有关的；对流层是大气最低、最密的一层，云和天气都在这里形成
senses.example: Most water vapour is held in the tropospheric layer.
senses.exampleCN: 大部分水汽都保存在对流层中。
senses.why: The Greek noun tropos means a turn, so the troposphere is the turning sphere; the adjective simply names whatever belongs to that turning layer.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语名词 tropos 意为「转动」，所以对流层就是「转动的那一层」；形容词只是给属于这一层的事物贴标签。

senses.title: Describing mixing in the air
senses.definition: relating to the overturning stirring of the lowest air layer, where warm air rises and cool air sinks
senses.definitionCN: 指与最底层空气不断翻搅混合有关：暖空气上升，冷空气下沉
senses.example: Strong tropospheric mixing carried the smoke to a faraway city.
senses.exampleCN: 强烈的对流层混合把烟尘带到了很远的一座城市。
senses.why: The root turn points at the physical overturning of air, so the adjective can highlight mixing rather than merely location.
senses.whyCN: 词根「转动」指向空气真实的翻搅，因此这个形容词可以强调混合，而不只是位置。

senses.title: Weather and storms
senses.definition: describing weather processes, such as clouds, rain and fronts, that develop in the lowest air layer
senses.definitionCN: 描述在最低大气层中形成的天气过程，如云、雨和锋面
senses.example: Forecasters track each tropospheric storm cell by radar.
senses.exampleCN: 预报员用雷达追踪每一个对流层风暴单体。
senses.why: Weather happens where the air turns and mixes, so the adjective naturally attaches to the storms that grow there.
senses.whyCN: 天气发生在空气翻腾混合之处，因此这个形容词自然跟在那里长成的风暴身上。

senses.title: Tropospheric ozone and pollution
senses.definition: used of gases and particles in the lowest air layer, especially those produced by pollution rather than in the upper atmosphere
senses.definitionCN: 用于指最低层大气中的气体和颗粒，尤指污染产生而非高空层所有的部分
senses.example: Car exhausts raise tropospheric ozone levels in summer cities.
senses.exampleCN: 汽车尾气抬高了夏季城市的对流层臭氧水平。
senses.why: The same molecule is a shield high above and a pollutant down below, so scientists use the layer name as a warning label.
senses.whyCN: 同样的分子在高空是保护层，在低处却是污染物，科学家于是用层名作警示标签。

senses.title: Radio propagation effects
senses.definition: describing bending or delay of radio signals caused by changes in temperature, pressure and moisture in the lowest air layer
senses.definitionCN: 描述由最低层空气的温度、气压和湿度变化造成的无线电信号弯曲或延迟
senses.example: Tropospheric ducting made the distant station easy to hear.
senses.exampleCN: 对流层波导传播让远处的电台变得容易收听。
senses.why: Radio waves bend where air density changes, so the adjective marks the layer that shaped the signal on its way.
senses.whyCN: 空气密度变化处无线电波会弯折，因此这个形容词标出的是「沿途塑造了信号」的那一层。

senses.title: Tropospheric temperature trends
senses.titleCN: 对流层温度趋势（气候研究）
senses.definition: used of long-term records of temperature in the lowest air layer, used by satellites to test climate models
senses.definitionCN: 用于指对流层温度的长期记录，卫星借此检验气候模型
senses.example: Satellite records track tropospheric warming above the polar regions.
senses.exampleCN: 卫星记录追踪极地上空对流层的增温。
senses.why: Climate science needs a named layer to compare against the surface and the stratosphere, and the adjective supplies that fixed label.
senses.whyCN: 气候科学需要一个有名字的层来与地面和平流层对比，这个形容词正好提供固定的标签。

senses.title: Tropospheric values in modelling
senses.definition: used in computer models of the atmosphere for variables such as mixing height, humidity and wind within the lowest layer
senses.definitionCN: 在大气计算机模式中，指最低层内混合高度、湿度和风等变量的取值
senses.example: The model stores each tropospheric mixing height for later diagnosis.
senses.exampleCN: 模式把每个对流层混合高度都存下来供后续诊断。
senses.why: A model needs to sort its numbers by layer, so the adjective becomes a technical prefix on variables rather than a description of skies.
senses.whyCN: 模式需要按层给数字归类，这个形容词于是成了变量前面的技术前缀，而不再是描写天空的定语。

senses.title: The lowest air of a world
senses.titleCN: 延伸义：某颗行星的低层大气
senses.definition: used loosely of the lowest air layer on a planet other than Earth, or figuratively of the lower atmosphere of a situation
senses.definitionCN: 扩展用于指地球以外行星的最低层大气，或比喻某种局面的低层氛围
senses.example: The probe measured tropospheric winds on the gas giant.
senses.exampleCN: 探测器测量了这颗气态巨行星的对流层风。
senses.why: Once a layer has a name, it can be pointed at any sky, and by extension at any situation with a low and a high region.
senses.whyCN: 某一层一旦有了名字，就可以指向任何天空，并进一步比喻任何有高低之分的局面。

intro.en: Tropospheric is built from the modern compound troposphere plus the Greek adjective ending -ic. The layer was named in the late nineteenth century and its existence was debated rather than simply assumed.
intro.cn: tropospheric 由现代复合名词 troposphere 加希腊语形容词词尾 -ic 构成。这一层是十九世纪末才定名的，其存在当初经过争论，并非理所当然。

items.en: Tropos means a turn or a turning, from trepein, to turn.
items.cn: tropos 意为「转动、转折」，来自动词 trepein「转动」。

items.en: Sphaira, a ball or sphere, reached English as -sphere, the usual ending for atmospheric layers.
items.cn: 希腊语 sphaira 意为「球」，经拉丁语传入英语成为词尾 -sphere，是各大气层的常用后缀。

items.en: Weather balloons and thermometers showed that temperature falls with height only up to a limit, which suggested a lowest mixing layer with a boundary above it.
items.cn: 探空气球和温度计显示气温只在某一高度以下随高度下降，这暗示存在一个位于上界之下的最底层混合层。

items.en: The term troposphere is often credited to the French meteorologist Philippe Teisserenc de Bort; the exact first use is not fully settled.
items.cn: troposphere 一词通常归于法国气象学家德博尔，确切的首用出处尚未完全确定。

items.en: English adopted troposphere and formed the adjective tropospheric from it, keeping the Greek -ic ending.
items.cn: 英语吸收 troposphere，并由它造出形容词 tropospheric，保留了希腊语词尾 -ic。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the same sphere family named by turning and by layering; the near-meaning group names the lowest air by physics rather than by Greek roots.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「球层」词族里用「转动」和「分层」命名的成员；近义组用物理说法而非希腊词根来称呼最低层大气。

entries.definition: The lowest layer of the atmosphere, where weather occurs.
entries.definitionCN: 大气最低的一层，天气现象发生在其中；是 tropospheric 的名词来源。

entries.definition: A line of latitude where the sun appears to turn back at a solstice.
entries.definitionCN: 太阳在至日看似折返的纬线；与 troposphere 共享 trepein「转动」词根。

entries.definition: The turning of a plant or organism towards or away from a stimulus.
entries.definitionCN: 植物或生物朝刺激转向或背离的运动；同出于「转动」词根。

entries.definition: Relating to the layer above the troposphere, where ozone filters sunlight.
entries.definitionCN: 指平流层，位于对流层上方，其中的臭氧过滤阳光。

entries.definition: Relating to the atmosphere as a whole, wider than any single layer.
entries.definitionCN: 指整个大气层，范围比任何单层都宽。

entries.definition: Describing the rising of warm fluid and sinking of cool fluid, the physical process that gives the troposphere its name.
entries.definitionCN: 描述暖流体上升、冷流体下沉的物理过程，正是这一过程给对流层取名。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Greek root trepein, the -sphere ending shared with other layers, and the technical phrases the word appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子用真实的希腊词根 trepein、与其他各层共有的 -sphere 词尾，以及这个词实际出现的专业搭配。

normal.en: Tropos means a turn, so the troposphere is the turning layer and tropospheric means belonging to it.
normal.cn: tropos 意为「转」，所以对流层就是「转动的层」，tropospheric 表示属于这一层。

normal.en: The -sphere ending is shared with stratosphere and mesosphere, so read the prefix and you know the layer.
normal.cn: 词尾 -sphere 与平流层、中间层共用，读出前面的词根就知道是哪一层。

normal.en: Tropospheric ozone is a pollutant, while stratospheric ozone is a shield; the layer name carries the warning.
normal.cn: 对流层臭氧是污染物，平流层臭氧是保护层；层名本身就带着警示。

normal.en: Tropospheric means of the troposphere, just as oceanic means of the ocean.
normal.cn: tropospheric 表示「对流层的」，就像 oceanic 表示「海洋的」一样。

normal.en: Compare tropospheric with atmospheric: the second is the whole air, the first is only its lowest turn.
normal.cn: 对比 tropospheric 与 atmospheric：后者指全部空气，前者只指其中最底下的那层翻搅。

abstract.en: Picture a glass jar of tea: warm water rises on one side, cool water slides down the other, and the whole jar keeps turning.
abstract.cn: 想象一杯热茶：温水从一侧上升，凉水从另一侧下沉，整杯水一直在打转——正是「转动」的画面。

abstract.en: Imagine the same rotation in a bowl of soup, where the swirl is what makes the spoon travel round the rim.
abstract.cn: 想象同一股旋转出现在一碗汤里，那圈漩涡正是让勺子绕着碗边转的动力。

abstract.en: Look up at a boiling cumulus cloud: it is a visible slice of a layer that never stops overturning.
abstract.cn: 抬头看一团翻滚的积云，它就是那一层永不停歇翻搅的空气的可见切片。

examples.en: Tropospheric winds carried the ash cloud towards the coast.
examples.cn: 对流层风把火山灰云带向海岸。

examples.en: The study compares tropospheric and surface temperature records.
examples.cn: 这项研究比较了对流层与地表的温度记录。

examples.en: Air pollution raises tropospheric ozone in many cities.
examples.cn: 空气污染抬高了许多城市的对流层臭氧水平。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「戳破 — 层」——一戳就破，说的是底下那层不断翻搅的空气：对流层；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 现代复合词：希腊语 tropos「转动」（来自 trepein「转」）+ 英语 -sphere「球层」→ troposphere「对流层」→ tropospheric「对流层的」。这一层的名字来自十九世纪末，首用者与确切年代尚有讨论。

sensesIntro.en: Tropospheric starts as a plain label for the lowest layer, then names its overturning air, the weather it carries, the pollutants it holds, the radio signals it bends, the climate trends it records, the values a model stores, and finally the lowest air of any world.
sensesIntro.cn: tropospheric 先是给最底层贴的普通标签，接着指这一层的翻搅、它承载的天气、它裹住的污染物、它弯曲的无线电信号、它记录的廓线趋势、模式里存下的取值，最后扩展到任何「世界」的最底层空气。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a layer of turning air, where warm rises, cool sinks and the whole skin of sky keeps churning.
core.cn: 核心意象：一层翻搅的空气，暖气上升、冷气下沉，整片天皮始终在打转。

branches.en: The plain locative sense: an object is labelled as belonging to the turning layer.
branches.cn: 最基本的定位义：给某个对象贴上「属于转动之层」的标签。

branches.en: The physics and weather line: the overturning motion is what builds clouds and storms.
branches.cn: 物理与天气线：正是翻搅运动造出了云与风暴。

branches.en: The pollution line: the same gases are judged by how high or low they sit.
branches.cn: 污染线：同样的气体，因所在位置高低而得到不同评价。

branches.en: The applied science line: signal bending and model variables use the layer as a technical tag.
branches.cn: 应用科学线：信号弯曲与模式变量都把这一层当作技术标签。

branches.en: The measurement and extension line: satellite trends and other worlds push the adjective beyond Earth.
branches.cn: 测量与延伸线：卫星趋势与其他行星把这一形容词推离地球。

intro.en: Tropospheric combines a Greek turning root with a layer ending and a Greek adjective ending; the nearest English relatives are other names of atmospheric spheres.
intro.cn: tropospheric 把希腊语「转动」词根、球层词尾与希腊语形容词词尾合在一起；最接近的英语亲属就是其他大气层的名称。

latinIntro.en: The sphere comes from Greek through Latin sphaera, and the turn from Greek trepein through tropos; neither element is Latin in origin, so the Latin list stays short.
latinIntro.cn: 「球」这一部分经拉丁语 sphaera 来自希腊语，「转动」部分经 tropos 来自希腊语 trepein；两者都不是拉丁语本源，因此拉丁语清单从简。

items.example: Tropos supplies the turning idea in the layer name.
items.exampleCN: tropos 为层名提供「转动」这一概念。

items.example: Trepein is the verb behind tropos.
items.exampleCN: trepein 是 tropos 背后的动词。

items.example: Sphaira became the -sphere ending of every layer name.
items.exampleCN: sphaira 成为每个层名的词尾 -sphere。

items.meaning: the lowest layer of the atmosphere
items.example: Troposphere fixes the turning layer in one word.
items.exampleCN: troposphere 用一个词固定了「转动之层」。

items.example: The suffix -ic makes tropospheric from troposphere.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ic 把 troposphere 变成 tropospheric。

items.example: The same ending names the stratosphere and mesosphere.
items.exampleCN: 同一词尾也用来命名平流层与中间层。
